FlowWorx / RoomOS AI

The room that thinks, speaks, decides and acts.

RoomOS AI turns meetings into governed business outcomes. It understands who is in the room and what they need, answers from authorised business data in any language, and turns approved decisions into owned tasks and workflows in the systems you already run.

Scope a focused pilot →See the five experiences →

Meetings produce talk. Your systems need accountable action.

Commitments lose ownership

Discussion rarely becomes structured tasks with clear owners and follow-through.

Context stays scattered

CRM, ITSM, projects, documents and past meetings hold disconnected knowledge.

Participation has friction

Global teams navigate language barriers and accessibility needs.

Transcripts are not enough

You need governance, privacy and ROI, not another meeting transcript.

Understand. Assist. Execute.

01 · Understand

Capture intent, context and participants. Retrieve only the business information each person is authorised to see.

02 · Assist

Support multilingual dialogue with grounded insights and recommendations, each with a source.

03 · Execute

Turn approved decisions into ServiceNow workflows, owned tasks and measurable outcomes.

Human approval connects a useful answer to an accountable action.

One platform for every room that matters.

ExperiencePromiseWhat happens
AI Boardroom · executive chief of staffA chief of staff for executive meetingsPrepare: agenda, KPIs, prior commitments and risks, compiled before you sit down · Support: grounded answers; blockers and decisions surfaced as you talk · Capture: owner, deadline, evidence and approvals for every commitment · Follow through: tasks drafted for confirmation, with completion and time-to-decision measured
Universal Language · real-time multilingual meetingsMeet in any language without losing contextEach attendee chooses: live captions or private translated audio · Your terminology stays intact: approved glossaries keep the language of your business · Notes keep their source: multilingual notes trace back to the original words · Consent first: accessibility options run only with participant consent
Autonomous War Room · incident commandA live command centre for critical incidentsTrigger and gather: a critical incident opens the room with affected services, recent changes and prior fixes · Collaborate: spoken questions answered with source links · Orchestrate: actions recommended, owners assigned, approved workflows started · Communicate: stakeholder updates and an auditable timeline
AI Deal Room · CRM-aware sellingCustomer conversations become pipelineArrive informed: account briefs from authorised CRM, proposals and history · Answer with approved facts: references, product facts and pricing on demand · Coach privately: seller prompts stay private, never broadcast · Keep the opportunity current: objections, buying signals and next steps drafted for review
Intelligent Workplace · self-managing roomsThe room reports and fixes its own issuesSense: supported room devices report health, occupancy and environment · Respond: repeated faults become incidents automatically; plain-language reporting with guided fixes · Optimise: privacy-conscious utilisation patterns help right-size workplace capacity

Reusable connectors, workflows and governance. All five experiences share the same grounding, approval gates and audit trail, governed by Singularity. Start with one room and add the rest without rebuilding.
